verse.verse_1: Surely there hath come upon man a space of time when he was not a thing worth mentioning.
verse.verse_2: Verily We! We created man from a sperm of mixtures, that We might prove him, wherefore We made him hearing, seeing.
verse.verse_3: Verily We! We shewed him the way; then he becometh either thankful or ingrate.
verse.verse_4: Verily We! We have gotten ready for the infidels chains and collars and a Blaze.
verse.verse_5: Verily the pious shall drink of a cup whereof the admixture is like Unto camphor.
verse.verse_6: From a fountain whence the bondmen of Allah will drink, causing it to gush abundantly.
verse.verse_7: They fulfill their vow and dread a Day the evil whereof shall be widespreading.
verse.verse_8: And they feed with food, for love of Him, the needy, and the orphan and the captive.
verse.verse_9: Saying: we feed you only for the sake of Allah; we desire not from you any recompense or thanks.
verse.verse_10: Verily we dread from our Lord a Day grim and distressful.
verse.verse_11: Wherefore Allah shall preserve them from the evil of that Day, and shall cause them to meet brightness and joy.
verse.verse_12: And shall recompense them for that which they patiently bare with a Garden and silken garment.
verse.verse_13: Reclining therein upon couches, they shall behold therein neither sun nor hurting cold.
verse.verse_14: And close upon them will be the shades thereof, and low will hang the clusters thereof greatly.
verse.verse_15: And brought round amongst them will be vessels of silver and also goblets of glass.
verse.verse_16: Godblets of silver, they shall have filled them to exact measure.
verse.verse_17: And therein they shall be given to drink of a cup whereof the admixture will be ginger.
verse.verse_18: From a fountain therein, named Salsabil.
verse.verse_19: And there shall go round Unto them youths ever-young. When thou seest them thou wouldst deem them pearls unstrung.
verse.verse_20: And when thou lookest them thou shalt behold delight and a dominion magnificent.
verse.verse_21: Upon them shall be garments of fine green silk and of brocades. And adorned they shall be with bracelets of silver: and their Lord shall give them drink a beverage pure.
verse.verse_22: Verily this is for you by way of recompense, and your endeavour hath been accepted.
verse.verse_23: Verily We! it is We Who have revealed Unto thee the Qur'an, a gradual revelation.
verse.verse_24: Wherefore persevere thou with the commandment of thy Lord, and obey not thou of them, any sinner or ingrate.
verse.verse_25: And remember thou the name of thy Lord in the morning and in the evening.
verse.verse_26: And during the night - worship Him; and hallow Him the livelong night.
verse.verse_27: Verily those love the Herein, and leave in front of them a heavy day.
verse.verse_28: It it We Who creared them and made them firm of make. And whenever We list, We can replace them with others like Unto them.
verse.verse_29: Verily this is an admonition; then whosoever Will, may choose a way Unto his Lord.
verse.verse_30: And ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Verily Allah is ever Knowing, Wise.'
verse.verse_31: He maketh whomsoever He listeth to enter His mercy. And the wrong-doers! for them He hath gotten ready a torment afflective.
